subject: Tenant Activation: project namespaces, API seed & invite cadence
messages:
From: Isabel Torres <isabel@novamed.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Jul 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Novamed onboarding kickoff / compliance items

Hi Laura,

Thanks — excited to get started. A couple of items we want to make sure are covered in the kickoff:
- Separate projects/namespaces for dev/staging/prod (we need strict separation).
- Admin API key scoping and rotation policy (we have a security checklist requiring key expiry).
- Service accounts for automation and CI (with limited privileges).
- SSO/SAML and MFA options, plus KMS for customer-managed keys.
- Audit log forwarding and retention (SOC2-ish requirements).

We can do an initial 45-minute call this week to align on the plan. Also looping in procurement (procurement@novamed.com) — they'll want a one-pager for billing and billing contacts.

Attached is our internal onboarding checklist so you can see the gating items from our side.

Best,
Isabel Torres
Director of Information Security
Novamed Health

Attachment: Novamed_Onboarding_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 82KB)

Subject: Re: Novamed onboarding kickoff / compliance items

Thanks Isabel — great list. Proposed onboarding plan below (keeps the initial rollout lightweight but addresses the security gates you called out). Please review and call out anything missing.

1) Project & namespace model (we will create):
   - novamed-dev (dev/test)
   - novamed-stage (staging/preprod)
   - novamed-prod (production)
   - Each project will have: 1 admin service account, 1 read-only observability account, and an external-ops account for billing.

2) API keys & service accounts:
   - Seed one short-lived admin API key for novamed-prod with 30d expiry (rotate before expiry).
   - Use service accounts for automation (scoped with minimal privileges).
   - We will deliver a tenant template JSON you can use to recreate projects via our API or console.

3) Identity & keys:
   - Recommend SSO (SAML) for admin console access; fallback to MFA + SCIM for user provisioning.
   - If you require customer-managed keys, we support KMS integration (we'll provide the IAM guide).

4) Audit & logs:
   - We'll enable audit forwarding to your SIEM (syslog/HTTPS) and provide structured audit export for 90 days by default.

5) Invite cadence & timing:
   - Week 0: Creation of projects + seed admin key + invite two admin users (security + platform).
   - Week 1: Invite engineering users + create service accounts for CI; start audit forwarding.
   - Week 2: Finalize SSO and rotate admin key to live KMS-backed key.

6) Compliance artifacts:
   - We will provide an implementation evidence bundle (SOC2-friendly): tenant-template.json, audit-samples, and an implementation checklist.

Attachments: novamed-tenant-template.json (tenant template, 3KB)

Quick implementation examples — CLI and API snippets for seeding the admin key and creating a service account:

CLI (rwdctl):
  # create project namespace
  rwdctl projects create --name novamed-prod --region us-west-2

  # create admin service account with expiry (ISO duration accepted)
  rwdctl keys create --project novamed-prod --role admin --expires 30d --output json > admin-key.json

API (curl):
  curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/novamed-prod/keys 
    -H 'Authorization: Bearer <bootstrap-token>' 
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
    -d '{"role":"admin","expires":"30d","note":"initial onboarding seed"}'

If that plan looks good, Monica will run the kickoff and Aditya will be our technical lead for the seed. Proposed kickoff slot: Wed Jul 12, 10:00-10:45 PT.

Laura Bennett
Implementation Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415-555-0199

Adding a few technical guardrails and notes to the plan that will help Novamed meet the security checklist quickly:

- Key scoping: our keys accept a JSON \"scopes\" claim. For example, limit the admin-key to \"projects:novamed-prod:*\" rather than org-wide. We'll include the scope in the sample key create call.

- Rotation automation: we recommend issuing the initial key with 30d expiry and configuring a rotation job in your CI (we can provide a small Helm chart / cronjob). Pseudocode:
  POST /v1/projects/novamed-prod/keys {role:admin, expires:30d, scopes:["projects:novamed-prod:*"]}
  store secret in your vault, run smoke test on new key, then revoke old key.

- Service accounts: create 1 service account per CI system (e.g., circleci-runner, github-actions) and scope to the minimal APIs (embed-only or generate-only). Avoid using admin keys in CI.

- Audit export format: we can ship logs as JSONL over HTTPS to your collector. We'll provide a sample mapping for Sysmon/CloudWatch ingestion.

- SSO notes: if you want SAML, we need the IdP metadata (entityID, ACS URL). If you want SCIM for provisioning, share the SCIM base URL and token owner.

I'll attach a short bash snippet you can paste into your onboarding runbook. Also happy to run the initial seed with Novamed on the kickoff call to reduce friction.

-- Aditya
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
